title: Create living changelog briefs and sprinted stakeholder signoff flow
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Problem: Release notes are prepared ad-hoc by PMs which causes inconsistent messaging across internal and customer channels, frequent last-minute edits, and missed stakeholder signoffs. Goal: Build a repeatable 'living changelog brief' template + a sprinted signoff flow so small releases and patches can be published with minimal friction and large releases get structured reviews. Scope: 1) Living changelog brief template (one-pager + TL;DR + rollout matrix + rollback notes + customer-facing blurb). 2) A lightweight signoff pipeline (PM -> Eng -> Design -> Legal/Security opt-in -> GTM notify) with deadlines and auto-reminders. 3) Integrations: Confluence template, Drive doc starter, GitHub PR checklist, Slack launch channel starter and a Jira/Linear automation to gate publish. Acceptance criteria: - Template created and validated by at least 3 PMs and 2 ENG leads. - Automation triggers created for reminders 72h/24h pre-publish. - Canonical public-facing changelog snippet produced for 3 pilot releases. Deliverables: living-changelog Confluence page (templated), GH PR checklist snippet, Slack announcement template, brief training doc for PMs, rollout automation in Linear.
